Name: Romance System Manager
Author: ganju0928
Description:
[b]Romance System Manager[/b] — manage Stardew Valley's romance system from inside the game. No more hunting for bouquets or waiting for festivals; everything is one keypress away.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Live NPC list (press F9):[/b] reads all social NPCs at runtime using the same filter as the game's social page — monsters, phantom characters and special-function NPCs are excluded, while NPCs from expansion mods (SVE, Ridgeside Village, etc.) are detected automatically.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Instant friendship editing:[/b] +1 / −1 / +5 hearts, or set exactly 8 hearts with one click (1 heart = 250 points). Changes save with your save file.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Romance toggle:[/b] enable or disable "can be romanced" for each NPC. Writes both the NPC instance and the character data, so in-game bouquet gifts actually work.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]One-click relationship status:[/b] set to Friendly / Dating / Engaged / Married / Divorced directly from a drop-down picker.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Bouquet simulation:[/b] send a bouquet to any NPC instantly.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Marriage info & daily interactions:[/b] shows days married and post-marriage behavior; daily spouse interaction hints, including multi-spouse setups (works with multiple-spouse mods such as 多元甜蜜 / Multiple Spouses).[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Search & filters:[/b] search by display name (Chinese or English); filter by All / Datable / Dating / Engaged / Married / Divorced / Roommate / Has record.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Fully localized UI:[/b] Chinese display names and statuses throughout.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Optional GMCM support:[/b] if Generic Mod Config Menu is installed, a config menu appears automatically; otherwise edit config.json.[/*]
[/list][b]Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.x for Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Unzip this mod into Stardew Valley/Mods/RomanceSystemManager/ (keep the folder name).[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Usage[/b]
[list]
[*]Press [b]F9[/b] (configurable in config.json) in-game to open the management interface.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Left panel: NPC list — click to select, scroll to browse, search and filter on top. Right panel: details and action buttons for the selected NPC.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]All changes apply immediately and are saved with your save file. Back up your save before making major changes.[/*]
[/list][b]Config (config.json)[/b]
[list]
[*]MenuKey: key to open the menu (default F9).[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]AutoRomanceOnLoad: auto-apply the romance NPC list when loading a save (default true).[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]RomanceNpcs: NPC names forced to be romanceable.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]DefaultHearts: hearts for newly-created relationship records (default 0).[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]MarriedDailyPoints: daily friendship points granted to spouses (default 20).[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]ShowMarriedHint: show daily spouse interaction hints (default true).[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 + SMAPI 4.0.0+.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Works alongside romance and marriage mods, including multi-spouse setups; no known conflicts.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Expansion-mod NPCs (SVE, Ridgeside, etc.) are detected automatically.[/*]
[/list][b]Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Editing relationship data changes game progression directly — keep a backup of your save file.[/*]
[/list][b]婚恋系统管理[/b] —— 直接在游戏内管理星露谷的婚恋系统。不用再满地图找花束、不用等节日，一键搞定。
[list]
功能特性
[*][list]
[*][b]实时 NPC 名单（按 F9）：[/b] 运行时读取所有社交 NPC，过滤条件与游戏社交页一致 —— 小怪、幻影角色、特殊功能角色自动排除；扩展模组（SVE、里奇赛德村等）的 NPC 自动识别纳入。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]好感度即时修改：[/b] +1 / −1 / +5 心，或一键设为 8 心（1 心 = 250 点）。修改随存档保存。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]恋爱开关：[/b] 逐 NPC 开启 / 关闭「可恋爱」。同时写入 NPC 实例与角色数据，游戏内手动送花即可正常接受。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]关系状态一键设置：[/b] 下拉直接设为 友好 / 恋爱中 / 已订婚 / 已婚 / 已离婚。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]模拟送花束：[/b] 一键向任意 NPC 赠送花束。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]婚后信息与每日互动：[/b] 显示已婚天数与婚后行为，婚后每日互动提示，多配偶（如多元甜蜜）同样适配。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]搜索与筛选：[/b] 支持中文 / 英文名搜索；按 全部 / 可恋爱 / 恋爱中 / 已订婚 / 已婚 / 已离婚 / 同居 / 有记录 筛选。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]界面全汉化：[/b] 人物显示名与状态信息全部中文。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]可选 GMCM 支持：[/b] 装了 Generic Mod Config Menu 会自动出现配置菜单；否则直接编辑 config.json。[/*]
[/list]安装[/*]
[*][list=1]
[*]为星露谷 1.6 安装 SMAPI 4.x。[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]解压本模组到 Stardew Valley/Mods/RomanceSystemManager/（保留文件夹名）。[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]用 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]使用方法[/*]
[*][list]
[*]游戏内按 [b]F9[/b]（可在 config.json 修改）打开管理界面。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]左侧：NPC 列表 —— 点击选中、滚轮翻页、顶部搜索与筛选；右侧：选中 NPC 的详情与操作按钮。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]所有修改即时生效并随存档保存。大改动前建议备份存档。[/*]
[/list]配置文件（config.json）[/*]
[*][list]
[*]MenuKey：打开界面的按键（默认 F9）。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]AutoRomanceOnLoad：读档时自动应用恋爱名单（默认 true）。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]RomanceNpcs：强制可恋爱的 NPC 名单。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]DefaultHearts：新建立关系记录的默认心数（默认 0）。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]MarriedDailyPoints：配偶每日好感点数（默认 20）。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]ShowMarriedHint：是否显示婚后每日互动提示（默认 true）。[/*]
[/list]兼容性[/*]
[*][list]
[*]星露谷 1.6 + SMAPI 4.0.0+。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]可与恋爱 / 结婚类模组共存（含多配偶），无已知冲突。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]扩展模组 NPC（SVE、里奇赛德等）自动识别。[/*]
[/list]说明[/*]
[*][list]
[*]直接修改关系数据会影响游戏进度 —— 请备份存档。[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
